data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Gate City Capital Management's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in ALCO, IPI, and CPHC.

CPHC had a new Schedule 13D (activist-style) ownership filing on October 1, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1672909/000139834426017759/0001398344-26-017759-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service based on public records and never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
